title: Library ledger with due dates and fines

authoring.author: Parikshaa content team
authoring.originality: Written for Parikshaa: our own project brief, code, tests and rubric for library ledger with due dates and fines, examples, code, quiz and explanations; no text from any site, book or course.

brief: Build the issue desk of a college library: a catalogue that knows how many copies of each book exist, and a ledger that issues books for 14 days, takes them back with a fine of ₹5 per late day, and prints an overdue report. Two classes in two modules talk to each other; the driver turns text commands into calls.
requirements: A book can be issued only if it exists, a copy is free, the member does not already hold that book, and the member holds fewer than 3 books.
Loans last 14 days; the due date is printed in ISO form.
A return on or before the due date has fine 0; each later day costs ₹5.
OVERDUE <date> lists loans past due on that date: most days late first, then member, then book code.
Bad numbers or dates print an error line instead of crashing.
io_protocol:
| Command | Prints |
|---|---|
| `BOOK <code> <copies>` | `book <code>: <total> copies` |
| `ISSUE <code> <member> <date>` | `issued <code> to <member>, due <date + 14>`, or an error |
| `RETURN <code> <member> <date>` | `returned <code>, fine <n>`, or `error: <code> is not with <member>` |
| `OVERDUE <date>` | `<member> <code> <days> days` lines, or `nothing overdue` |
| `AVAILABLE <code>` | `<code>: <n> available` |

Issue errors, checked in this order: `error: no book <code>`, `error: <member> already has <code>`, `error: no copies of <code> left`, `error: <member> already has 3 books`. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; a bad number or date prints `error: bad value in <line>`.

milestones.title: Catalogue and issuing
milestones.instructions: Fill in `Catalogue` and `Ledger.issue` with its four checks, in the order the protocol lists them.
hints: Store the due date as a date object; timedelta(days=14) adds the loan period.
A member's count is the number of loan keys with their name.

milestones.title: Returns and fines
milestones.instructions: Fill in `Catalogue.give_back` and `Ledger.give_back`. The fine is ₹5 for each day after the due date.
hints: (return_day - due).days is negative for early returns; clip it with max(0, ...).
Remove the loan with dict.pop so the same book can be returned only once.

milestones.title: Overdue report
milestones.instructions: List loans whose due date is before the given day, sorted by days late (most first), then member, then code.
hints: Sort tuples with a key like (-days, member, code).
A loan due on the report day itself is not overdue yet.

rubric.criterion: Hidden tests pass: every command prints exactly the expected output.
Catalogue owns copy counts and Ledger owns loans; neither reaches into the other's dictionaries, and dates are date objects, not strings.
Readable names, small functions and clear error handling (AI feedback, advice only).

extensions: Allow renewing a loan once for another 14 days.
Cap each loan's fine at ₹200 and print each member's total fine.
